entities.summary: Rabban al-Qas was an Iraqi prelate of the Chaldean Catholic Church. He served as Bishop of Amadiya from 2001 to 2021. He also served as Bishop of Zakho from 2013 until 2020 when the Eparchy of Amadiya was split from the Eparchy of Zakho.
